# Local LLM Sketch

> Local LLM Sketch is a sideload-only fork of OnDevice LLM: a Swift/SwiftUI
> local-first AI workbench for iPhone, with an in-app browser the assistant can
> drive. Run language, vision, speech, and image-generation models on-device,
> with optional authenticated local APIs for AI clients and agents.

Product name: Local LLM Sketch
Repository: https://github.com/arthurdcosta311-sketch/local-llm-sketch
License: MIT for original project code and documentation
Xcode target and scheme: OnDeviceLAS
Upstream project (not this fork): OnDevice LLM, https://github.com/Mesutcydev/ios-local-llm

## Tools the assistant has here

- browser_read, browser_navigate, browser_desktop_mode, browser_download
- files_list, files_read, files_write
- shell (ls, cat, head, wc, grep, swift, git — audited, no fork/exec)
- github_repo_files, github_read, github_commit, github_build, github_runs
- web_search, web_browse

## What is not available

- No Linux virtual machine (no hypervisor, no JIT-backed emulator bundled).
- No on-device compiler, package manager, or git binary.
- No Chrome/Firefox extension bridge in the browser.

## Capabilities

- On-device LLM chat and code assistance with MLX and llama.cpp
- Camera, screenshot, OCR, and vision-language-model analysis
- Local transcription, voice activity detection, and text-to-speech
- On-device image generation
- Hugging Face model discovery, admission checks, downloads, and lifecycle
- Thermal-aware generation and coordinated model residency
- OpenAI-, Anthropic-, and Ollama-compatible local HTTP routes
- Structured tool calling and a pairing-authenticated iPhone-to-Mac agent link

## Important boundaries

- Model weights and generated native frameworks are not included in Git.
- Downloaded models have independent licenses.
- Local API access is opt-in, bearer-authenticated HTTP for trusted networks.
- The project does not silently send local prompts or captures to a cloud
  inference service.
- Simulator results do not prove physical-device thermal or Jetsam behavior.
